description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions related to fetching and processing user data in a frontend React application. It includes a custom hook `useUsers` for fetching user data from an API, with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering, and a utility function `aggregateUsersByDepartment` for summarizing users by their department.

methods.name: useUsers({ page, limit, sort, filter } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that fetches user data from the backend API, manages loading and error states, and supports query parameters such as page, limit, sort, and filter.

methods.name: aggregateUsersByDepartment(users)
methods.description: A utility function that takes an array of user objects and returns an array of departments with their respective user counts, excluding invalid or unknown department entries.
